subject.title: fix(reply): strip leaked current-message scaffolding and (no output) placeholders

question: Should OpenClaw accept this shared sanitizer and normalizer behavior as the core reply-delivery contract for copied current-message scaffolding and bare `(no output)` placeholders?
rationale: The patch has no concrete code defect, but it changes the shared delivery path that decides whether final text or non-text payloads are sent across channels, so maintainer intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Land after clean checks and delivery review
options.body: Rerun or triage the two failing broad shards, then merge if maintainers accept the shared sanitizer and skip-reason contract.
